parts:
Hi,

I attempted to load CSV file from HDFS into Tessera as a DDF and got an error. I am using AWS EMR with the latest launch Tessera in EMR scripts.

The CSV file is from:
http://stat-computing.org/dataexpo/2009/1987.csv.bz2

I uncompressed the file and load it into /data/ directory in HDFS using hadoop fs -put

I then had to change the ownership of /data/ directory so Tessera can access it.

The R command are as follows. Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: Re: Reading CSV file error - 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'
parts:
Thanks for the detailed report.

This looks like a familiar error I’ve seen with RStudio when using datadr.  I have no idea the cause and we have filed these errors with RStudio, but these are always red herrings.  Even though there is an error, it has something to do with the RStudio IDE, and there was not an error in the execution of your code.  The error can be ignored completely.  Your output object should be fine.  take a look at data.2008 and see if it looks in tact.  If it doesn't, try intializing a ddf:

ddf(hdfsConn(loc="/user/tessera-user/data-out-01”)

The data should be there.

If not, I’m wrong and we’ll have to investigate further.
